entities.name: WorklogDomain
observations: 2026-05-28: Primary entry point is src/components/worklog/worklog-page.tsx
2026-05-28: Editor is src/components/worklog/worklog-editor.tsx (Tiptap 3 + Yjs, StarterKit with undoRedo:false)
2026-05-28: Three-pane layout: folders-rail (left) + notes-list (center) + editor/reader (right) — SUPERSEDED 2026-06-05 by ADR-0013, see below
2026-05-28: Draft persistence via server-backed sync — ADR-0009. Draft flush race condition if editor unmounts before debounce fires.
2026-05-28: Inline photo support (Phase 2b) and read-mode renderer (Phase 2c) confirmed working as of May 2026
2026-05-28: API routes under src/app/api/work-logs/. Hooks under src/components/worklog/hooks/

2026-06-05: ADR-0013 — section nav override architecture. Folders/Notable/Templates/Categories moved out of WorklogFoldersRail into the global sidebar via <WorklogNavSidebar>. Sidebar.tsx swaps when pathname.startsWith('/worklog') AND not collapsed. Collapsed sidebar = escape hatch back to top-level nav.
2026-06-05: /worklog page is now 2-pane (notes-list + reader); rail removed. Activity widget (streak/heatmap/this-month/notable) lives at top of notes-list pane via <WorklogActivityWidget>.

2026-06-05: <WorklogPage compact /> dashboard embed is UNCHANGED — still 3-pane with internal WorklogFoldersRail + own DnD provider. compact mode opts out of URL state via useFolderSelection({ enabled: false }).

2026-06-05: Folder selection state is URL-driven via useFolderSelection() hook. URL contract: ?folder=all|notable|unfiled|category:<key>|<cuid> and ?view=templates. Setter uses router.push (back/forward navigates folders). Any new caller mutating folder selection must go through this hook — do not add useState<FolderSelection> back into worklog-page.tsx.

2026-06-05: WorklogDndProvider is now mounted in LayoutShell (conditionally on /worklog) so the DndContext spans both the override sidebar AND the page. Worklog-page.tsx no longer mounts its own DndProvider in non-compact mode.

2026-06-05: Open follow-up sprint — 'worklog-as-landing-page' redesign. /worklog would become a curated home (quick-capture hero, today's notes, stat cards, folder grid, recent list) with the existing 2-pane list+reader relocated to /worklog/notes. Mockup at public/mockups/worklog-landing.html. Three open questions: (1) Today section card vs one-liner, (2) routing /worklog/notes vs ?view=notes, (3) Quick Capture inline-save vs escalate-to-editor.

2026-06-06: ADR-0014 SHIPPED — /worklog split into two routes: /worklog (home, capture-first) and /worklog/notes (existing 2-pane list+reader, moved verbatim). New (app)/worklog/layout.tsx mounts <FullBleedShell> once for both. Sidebar override (ADR-0013) gates on pathname.startsWith('/worklog') so it covers both routes unchanged.

2026-06-06: WorklogHomeView composes 5 section components in src/components/worklog/home/: worklog-quick-capture (hero, escalates via router.push to /worklog/notes?focus=<id>), worklog-today-list (one-liner today notes), worklog-stat-cards (streak sparkline / month / notable), worklog-folder-grid (top 8 by recent activity + Templates tile), worklog-recent-list (earlier-this-week one-liners). Home is read-only — no internal state, no URL params consumed.
2026-06-06: <WorklogActivityWidget> REMOVED from /worklog/notes. Lives only on /worklog home now. Worklog-page.tsx no longer imports it.

2026-06-06: WorklogNavSidebar now has a 'Home' row (<Link href='/worklog'>, active when pathname === '/worklog'). Filter rows (All notes / Notable / Templates / folders / categories) navigate cross-route to /worklog/notes when clicked from /worklog; when already on /worklog/notes they mutate URL params via useFolderSelection setter. Filter active state suppressed on /worklog (the home page does not represent a filter).

2026-06-06: New helper exported from use-folder-selection.ts: selectionToQueryString(selection) builds the query-string for a target FolderSelection without binding to current pathname — used for cross-route navigation from the worklog home into /worklog/notes.

2026-06-07: Worklog rail and folder-tree localStorage keys ('worklog-rail-activity-open', 'worklog-rail-categories-open', 'worklog-folder-tree-expanded') migrated to 'resumsify:worklog:*' namespace via central STORAGE_KEYS registry (see StorageKeysModule). Migration is lazy on first mount; legacy keys auto-removed once new key is populated.

2026-06-07: /worklog/notes document-manager UI (ADR-0015) self-audit complete. View-mode radiogroup now has full ARIA keyboard nav (roving tabindex, arrow keys, Home/End, wrap). Sort menu, select-all in bulk mode, and shared notes module shipped. Reader-as-route navigation deferred to ADR-0015 Phase 5–6.

2026-06-07: ADR-0015 Phase 5 SHIPPED — reader-as-route + drawer-preview pattern. Two-tier read model: row click opens half-page drawer (read-only preview) at ?focus=<id>; drawer 'Open' button routes to /worklog/notes/[id] full-screen.

2026-06-07: New components: <WorklogNoteReadView> (pure read-only renderer, no editor mount, used by both drawer and full-screen route) and <WorklogReaderDrawer> (drawer chrome, owns open/close lifecycle).

2026-06-07: URL contract — `/worklog/notes` (drawer closed), `/worklog/notes?focus=<id>` (drawer open, read mode), `/worklog/notes/[id]` (full-screen, edit). Setter is router.replace(href, {scroll:false}) so back-button escapes the whole preview model, not individual previews. buildNotesUrl() round-trips ALL non-focus params via URLSearchParams.

2026-06-07: Drawer dimensions — mobile = full sheet (inset-0), desktop = right rail (md:inset-y-0 md:right-0 md:w-[min(600px,50vw)]). Slide animation translate-x-full ↔ translate-x-0 + transition-transform duration-200 ease-out. NOT a Dialog primitive (Dialog focus-trap + scroll-lock fights 'list still interactive while drawer open').
2026-06-07: Full-screen route width changed max-w-3xl → max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4. Older 3xl felt cramped on modern monitors with the document-manager-style title chrome.

2026-06-07: Legacy ?focus= callers migrated from /worklog to /worklog/notes — command-palette.tsx, equipment-usage-history.tsx (single-note path only), position-worklog-tab.tsx (single-note path only), worklog/quick-capture-dialog.tsx. ?focusEquipment= and ?focusPosition= deliberately NOT migrated — those are list-filter intents on the legacy /worklog route, semantically opposite of single-note ?focus=.
2026-06-07: Worklog sidebar font size bumped to match main sidebar (worklog-nav-sidebar.tsx). Visual consistency tweak.

2026-06-07: Two new ADRs queued — ADR-0016 (note-to-note linking + backlinks, Proposed) and ADR-0017 (worklog version history + visual diff, Proposed). Both build on ADR-0015 drawer as the natural surface for future Backlinks/History tabs.

2026-06-09: ADR-0020 — voice dictation v1 (Web Speech, ephemeral, browser-native). Lives under src/components/worklog/voice/ as 4 files: types.ts (provider/mode seam reserved for v1.5 OpenAI + v3 whisper.cpp), use-voice-dictation.ts (hook), use-voice-consent.ts (narrow projection of useWorklogPreferences sharing ['worklog-preferences'] cache key), voice-dictation-button.tsx (mic icon + consent dialog + error toast), voice-dictation-consent-dialog.tsx (one-time consent UI per ADR-0020 copy lock).

2026-06-09: Voice button mounted on two surfaces — Quick Capture (next to 'Notes' label) and Tiptap toolbar (after Insert dropdown, separator before mic). Surfaces only pass onFinalChunk; pattern is editor.chain().focus().insertContent for Tiptap or setContent appender for textarea. New surfaces use docs/workflows/add-voice-input-surface.md recipe.

2026-06-09: WorkLogPreference gained voiceDictationConsentedAt (DateTime?, nullable) — one-way consent timestamp. WorklogPreferences type + EMPTY_PREFERENCES + API route GET/PUT/upsert all read+write it. Cache key ['worklog-preferences'] is shared between useWorklogPreferences and useVoiceConsent — do not fork.

2026-06-09: Web Speech 'not-allowed' is overloaded — fires for both permission-denied AND no-mic-connected (NotFoundError under the hood). Deterministic disambiguator is navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true}) in console. Friendly toast addresses both possibilities + appends raw code as (diagnostic: code="...") suffix so user can paste exact code in bug report.

2026-06-09: Pre-existing dev DB drift means new prefs columns must be added via 'prisma db execute --stdin' with ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, not prisma migrate dev. Drift includes Asset tables, JobAsset.assetType→assetTypeId rename, WorkLog.search_vector tsvector generated column. Migration history is out of sync — flag in any future schema-touch handoff.

2026-06-09: Smoke test for voice deferred — mini PC has no built-in mic, NotFoundError confirmed via getUserMedia probe. Implementation + error path validated end-to-end (button → hook → tagged error → toast). Happy path verification pending USB mic or phone-over-LAN.

2026-06-09: SUPERSEDES the 2026-06-09 prefs-column-via-db-execute note. Dev DB drift was resolved by the baseline-drift capture migration (20260609180000_baseline_drift_capture, commit 1f12fcc). `prisma migrate dev` is again the correct tool for new prefs columns. See PrismaSchemaOps entity + docs/workflows/recover-from-prisma-drift.md.

[2026-06-09 bug-fix] ADR-0016 worklog chip labels were initially derived from contentJson first-line, ignoring WorkLog.title. Fixed by extracting shared helper deriveWorklogLabel({ title, contentJson, date }) at src/lib/worklog/derive-worklog-label.ts with fallback chain title.trim() -> first non-empty line -> ISO date, all truncated to 80 chars.

[2026-06-09 bug-fix] mention-search worklog branch search clause changed from content-only contains to OR: [{ title: contains }, { content: contains }] so users can find notes by typing visible chip text. backlinks route + mention-search route now both select WorkLog.title and route through the shared helper.

[2026-06-09 bug-fix] Pure migration helper rewriteWorklogMentionLabels(doc, lookup) at src/lib/worklog/rewrite-worklog-mention-labels.ts walks ProseMirror doc, rewrites mention chip labels with entityType='worklog'. Idempotent. Used by scripts/migrations/2026-06-09-fix-worklog-mention-labels.ts (npx tsx, --dry-run flag supported). Pattern: build label lookup from full WorkLog table, walk each doc, update only when changed.

[2026-06-09 lesson] Recurring miss when wiring a new mention entity type: forgetting that the canonical record has a primary display field (title/name/company) and instead deriving the chip label from a secondary projection. Workflow recipe at docs/workflows/wire-mention-entity-type.md rev 2 now codifies: (a) always check Prisma model for primary display field FIRST, (b) search clause MUST include the same field as label, (c) extract a derive*Label helper at rule-of-three.
[2026-06-09] Test counts post-fix: 364/364 pass (was 343 pre-fix). Added 10 helper tests + 8 mutator tests + 3 mention-search tests.

entities.name: WorklogReaderDrawer
observations: 2026-06-07: Path src/components/worklog/worklog-reader-drawer.tsx. Drawer chrome — owns open/close lifecycle, header (✕ + Open link + kebab DropdownMenu with Delete), body (spinner / empty / WorklogNoteReadView).
2026-06-07: Receives row object as prop — does NOT fetch data. Reads from the same TanStack Query cache that backs the list, so no duplicate network call.
2026-06-07: Esc key closes via window-level keydown listener. No focus-trap, no body-scroll-lock — list keyboard nav must keep working while drawer is open.
2026-06-07: Delete flow — close drawer FIRST (clear ?focus via router.replace), THEN fire delete mutation. Reverse order causes a 'note not found' flash while router.replace is committing.
2026-06-07: 'Open' link strips `focus` from URL (URLSearchParams clone + delete), forwards every other deep-link param to /worklog/notes/[id]. Cosmetic but signals URL hygiene was thought through.

entities.name: WorklogNoteReadView
observations: 2026-06-07: Path src/components/worklog/worklog-note-read-view.tsx. Pure read-only renderer of a WorkLog row. NO autosave, NO editor mount, NO draft handling.
2026-06-07: Composition — title + notable star, meta strip (date · category · position · hours · folder · mood), tag Badges, photo grid, body via existing <WorklogNoteView> static reader.
2026-06-07: Used by BOTH the drawer (preview tier) AND the full-screen route /worklog/notes/[id] (focus tier). One renderer, two surfaces — do NOT fork.
